title: Quietly Comforting Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A sweet and comforting Algerian dish featuring lamb, cheddar cheese, and a blend of spices, perfect for a low-fat friendly meal. This tagine is a hearty and flavorful stew that is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, dried apricots, and browned lamb, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine or Dutch oven, and simmer the stew for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese and cook until it is melted and the stew is heated through.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
